name: Group Work Day
description: Split into groups and work through a shared to-do list — any group member checks items off, the projector shows every group's live progress. The template for lab days, stations, and project work.

intro.message:
✅ GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups. Every group has the same checklist on their devices — check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group.
items: Assign one recorder and one reporter
Check your answers with another group

end.message: ✅ That's Group Work Day! Swap in your own tasks for any lab, stations, or project session.
